sources.entry: WeeWX - Open source software for your weather station. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Python/deb

summary.one_liner: WeeWX is open source Python software that collects data from home weather stations and sensors, then generates plots, web pages, and reports and uploads them to websites and online weather services.
summary.what_it_does: WeeWX collects data from many weather station models and sensors, including Davis, Fine Offset, Oregon Scientific, LaCrosse, AcuRite, and one-wire devices, plus software defined radio. It generates plots, HTML pages, and monthly and yearly summary reports from that data. Output can be pushed to a web server via FTP, FTPS, or rsync. It also uploads weather data to many online weather services and publishes to MQTT and InfluxDB. The README mentions multiple skins, US and metric units, localized date/time and internationalized language support, and extensive almanac information. Storage is sqlite or MySQL.
use_cases: run a home weather station and publish its data online
generate weather graphs and web pages from station data
upload station data to weather services like Weather Underground
push weather data to MQTT or InfluxDB
run weather software on a Raspberry Pi
produce monthly and yearly weather summary reports
notable: Runs on Linux, macOS, Solaris, and BSD, and runs well on a Raspberry Pi
Supports a wide range of weather station hardware from many manufacturers
Uploads to many online weather services
Simple internal design that is easily extended with Python
caveats: README does not include install commands; installation is covered in external guides
Hardware support varies by model; the README lists supported hardware but says it is not exhaustive
